 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary Hearing,
This Day, Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Suraj Govindaraj
 Oral Order
1.

Ms. Reshma K.T., learned counsel accept notice for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
2.

Petitioner is before this court seeking for the following reliefs:
(a) To quash the impugned notice/closer letter dated 16/5/2024 vide ANNEXURE-H issued by the Respondent No-3, and also,
(b) Issue directions to the respondent No-3 to renewal of the passport of the petitioner by considering the renewal application and pass any other relief deems fit on the facts and circumstances case, in the interest of justice and equity.
3. Petitioner had applied for re-issuance of a passport which had expired on 03.08.2024 alleging that the said NC: 2025:KHC:54441 HC-KAR application has not been considered, the petitioner is Smt Geetha Karthikeyan vs The Union Of India on 18 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14388077/
2 before this Court seeking for the aforesaid reliefs.
4.

sentences.text:
Ms. Reshma K.T., learned counsel for the respondents, submits that there is a criminal proceedings in C.C.No.1522/2020 which is pending before the XI ACMM Court, Bengaluru, a charge sheet has been laid for offences under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code wherein the petitioner has also been implicated and it is for that reason that the application could not be processed.
5.

Even if the petitioner is an accused in those proceedings, I am of the considered opinion that the right to travel being a fundamental right under Article 21 of the Constitution of India and taking into consideration that the petitioner wants to travel to Australia where the naming ceremony of her grandchild is to be held, the petitioner cannot be deprived of such travel.
Of course, such travel would have to be subject to prior permission and conditions that may be imposed by the XI ACMM Court, Bengaluru, seized of C.C No.1522/2020.
NC: 2025:KHC:54441 HC-KAR 6.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Writ petition is allowed.
ii) A certiorari is issued.
The letter dated 16.05.2024 at Annexure-H issued by respondent No.3 is quashed.

iii) Respondent No.3 is directed to consider the application for re-issuance of the passport submitted by the petitioner in terms of the above observation and issue the passport within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

iv) The travel of the petitioner shall, however, be subject to prior permission to be obtained by the petitioner from the XI ACMM Court, Bengaluru, in C.C.No.1522/2020 and subject to such conditions as the said Court may impose on the travel of the petitioner.

SD/-
(SURAJ GOVINDARAJ) JUDGE GJM List No.: 1 Sl No.: 14 Smt Geetha Karthikeyan vs The Union Of India on 18 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14388077/
